label: lem:compact_subset_open_collar
title: Compact subset of an open set has a positive collar
statement:
Let \(K,U \subset \C\). If \(K\) is compact, \(U\) is open, and \(K \subset U\),
    then there exists \(\rho > 0\) such that
    \[
      \{z \in \C : \dist(z,K) < \rho\} \subset U .
    \]
proof:
Since \(K\) is compact and \(U^c\) is closed, and since \(K \cap U^c=\varnothing\),
    the distance between \(K\) and \(U^c\) is positive. Choose \(\rho\) smaller than
    this distance. (In Mathlib this is essentially
    \texttt{IsCompact.exists\_thickening\_subset\_open}.)
notes: Signature: `lemma compact_subset_open_has_thickening {K U : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hU : IsOpen U) (hKU : K ⊆ U) : ∃ ρ > 0, {z : ℂ | Metric.infDist z K < ρ} ⊆ U`. Uses `Metric.infDist` to phrase the collar. Provable from Mathlib's `IsCompact.exists_thickening_subset_open` (which gives the same conclusion as `Metric.thickening ρ K ⊆ U`).
